messages.content: A starving hunter, tracking an animal.

Rad-stag. But my last arrow just broke. A hunter with no arrows isn't much of a hunter. Don't suppose you have any to spare?
{"give":[],"take":[]}
I can spare a few. [OFFER: bundle_of_arrows]

You're a lifesaver. Here, a bit of hunter's knowledge for your trouble: the rad-stags always travel east to drink at dawn. You can catch them unawares if you're quiet.
{"give":["hunting_tip"],"take":["bundle_of_arrows"],"scan":true}
